label: Bible Study
prompt: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the _____.
verse: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.
note: Desert flowers in prophecy — the wilderness breaking into bloom when God redeems.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer: for I _____ God, that it shall be even as it was told me.
verse: Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer: for I believe God, that it shall be even as it was told me.
note: In a storm with 276 souls aboard, Paul's pep talk is simple: be of good cheer, for I believe God.

label: Sunday School
prompt: So David took the spear and the _____ of water from Saul's bolster; and they gat them away, and no man saw it, nor knew it, neither awaked: for they were all asleep; because a deep sleep from the LORD was fallen upon them.
verse: So David took the spear and the cruse of water from Saul's bolster; and they gat them away, and no man saw it, nor knew it, neither awaked: for they were all asleep; because a deep sleep from the LORD was fallen upon them.
note: David crept into Saul's camp and left with the king's spear and water cruse — proof he could have struck, and didn't.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Now ye are the body of Christ, and _____ in particular.
verse: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.
note: Paul's body metaphor lands: the eye can't fire the hand, and every member of the church matters.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much _____ because of the way.
verse: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.
note: The long detour around Edom wore Israel down — 'much discouraged because of the way' — and the fiery serpents followed.
